description: This file implements a Kubernetes CA signer component responsible for signing CSRs using local disk keys, including controllers for different signer types and CSR validation logic.

classes.name: CSRSigningController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing CSR signing and certificate renewal.

classes.name: signer
classes.description: Handles CSR signing logic, signer verification, and certificate issuance.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the CSR signing controller and dynamic certificate reloader.

methods.name: NewKubeletServingCSRSigningController
methods.description: Creates a CSR signing controller for kubelet serving certificates.

methods.name: NewKubeletClientCSRSigningController
methods.description: Creates a CSR signing controller for kubelet client certificates.

methods.name: NewKubeAPIServerClientCSRSigningController
methods.description: Creates a CSR signing controller for API server client certificates.

methods.name: NewLegacyUnknownCSRSigningController
methods.description: Creates a CSR signing controller for legacy unknown signer.

methods.name: NewCSRSigningController
methods.description: General function to create a CSR signing controller with specified parameters.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a CSR, verifies, and signs it if valid.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs a CSR, returning a PEM-encoded certificate.

methods.name: duration
methods.description: Determines the certificate duration based on requested expiration or default.

methods.name: getCSRVerificationFuncForSignerName
methods.description: Returns verification function based on signer name.

methods.name: isKubeletServing
methods.description: Verifies if CSR is for kubelet serving.

methods.name: isKubeletClient
methods.description: Verifies if CSR is for kubelet client.

methods.name: isKubeAPIServerClient
methods.description: Verifies if CSR is for API server client.

methods.name: isLegacyUnknown
methods.description: Verifies if CSR is for legacy unknown signer.

methods.name: validAPIServerClientUsages
methods.description: Validates usages for API server client certificates.

methods.name: usagesToSet
methods.description: Converts usages slice to set for validation.
